The Special Initiatives wing, which was formed in the year 2003, processes special initiative schemes / projects that emanate from different sources, in consultation with respective administrative departments of the Secretariat and other line departments. The Chennai Metropolitan Area (CMA) has an extensive public transportation network which comprises of Chennai Metro Rail System (Phase-I), Metropolitan Transport Corporation (MTC), Suburban Rail System, and Mass Rapid Transit System (MRTS). The Chennai Metro Rail Limited (CMRL) was incorporated as a State-owned Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV) under the Companies Act to implement metro rail projects in December 2007. Under this arrangement, the Government of India nominates five Directors to the Board of Directors, including the Secretary, Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, Government of India, as Chairman. On the other hand, the State Government nominates five Directors, including the Managing Director.
